title: PhysicsMeshCollisionAPI
summary: Chooses how a Mesh collider is approximated for PhysX. Its single token column selects the descriptor kind and which cooking API's columns are consulted; without the API a Mesh is a plain triangle mesh.
producer_scope: Every declared attribute of an applied collision API is published at its resolved value, so physics:approximation lands as none when unauthored. The API is part of the producer's physics schema set; applying it to a non-Mesh Gprim publishes the column but the consumer ignores it there.

columns.name: physics:approximation
columns.absent: none: a triangle mesh collider with SDF cooking disabled (sdfResolution 0). The same result as not applying the API. Accepted tokens: none, convexHull, convexDecomposition, boundingSphere, boundingCube, meshSimplification, sphereFill, sdf. Any other token also resolves to none (the parser's safe fallback; the consumer's routing site logs and rejects an unsupported combination).
columns.notes: Read as a token id and compared against the interned token set. Shape descriptor per token: none -> triangle mesh; convexHull -> convex mesh; convexDecomposition -> convex decomposition; boundingSphere -> bounding sphere with pre-scaled points; boundingCube -> bounding box with pre-scaled points; meshSimplification -> triangle mesh with quadric simplification; sphereFill -> sphere points; sdf -> triangle mesh with SDF cooking params. Not verified: a token sample cannot be written by the generated test and the resulting PhysX kind also depends on the body (see the promotion interaction) and on real mesh data.

interactions.rule: Silent promotion: none or meshSimplification on a collider whose rigid body has physics:rigidBodyEnabled true and physics:kinematicEnabled false is rewritten to convexHull before the descriptor is built, because PhysX rejects a non-SDF triangle mesh as a dynamic simulation shape. The column keeps its authored value; only the descriptor changes.
Meaningful only on a Mesh. Cube, Sphere, Capsule, Cylinder, Cone and Plane dispatch by prim type before the approximation is consulted.
Consulted only for convexHull (including the promoted case).
Consulted only for sdf, and only when that API is applied with a positive sdfResolution; otherwise the sdf mesh cooks as a plain triangle mesh.
Read for convexHull and convexDecomposition approximations without checking usd-schemas, when the matching PhysX hullVertexLimit is absent.
